original.statement: Support for MirrorMaker 1 is removed in Strimzi 0.46, so deployments must migrate to MirrorMaker 2 before upgrading to 0.46 or newer.

decision.reason: [ev-87094cfdd770] says MirrorMaker 1 support has been removed and tells operators to "make sure to migrate to MirrorMaker 2 before upgrading to Strimzi 0.46 or newer". That is an explicit operator step that must happen before the upgrade, so the migration family with change type migration-required fits. The name migrate-to-mirrormaker-2 is kebab-case built from the evidence's own words. [ev-5d8b8b113b70] restates the removal.
